title:
Private Entrance
1 Bdrm Apartment w/Full kitchen
description:
PRIVATE ENTRY- Newly remodeled 1 BDRM/1 Bath Suite with full kitchen. 5 miles from the airport, Opryland Hotel and the famous lower Broadway area. 1 Bedroom with Queen bed and another queen bed in the large spacious living room. Back patio with recliners and nature setting. Private back yard for relaxing. Lrg Bathroom w/heated floors. Driveway parking.

The space
You basically have the whole downstairs to yourself. Park in the driveway and walk around to your private entrance. Full living room with large bathroom, laundry room and 1 bedroom/kitchenette combo. 2 beds, 2 couches and a lazy boy chair for relaxing.Local restaurants, gas and groceries less then a mile from the house. You can walk if necessary.

Guest access
Driveway and private entrance

Other things to note
This is a 2 level house. I live upstairs. The downstairs suite is totally private. The back porch is covered and has a great view of a wooded backyard that regularly has varied wildlife. Deer, groundhogs, hawks, the occasional fox, etc. Great place to relax with a cup of coffee in the morning or in the evenings before the nightlife begins.
